user_requirement: Help me create a blog webpage that can upload images

requirements.title: Image-Enabled Blog Webpage
requirements.description: A user-friendly blog webpage that supports creating, publishing, and viewing blog posts with integrated image upload functionality, allowing users to enhance textual content with visual media.

features.name: Image Upload for Blog Posts
features.description: Provide an interface for users to select and upload images from their local device to include in blog posts, with support for common formats (JPG, PNG, GIF) and basic validation for file size and type to ensure compatibility.

features.name: Rich Blog Post Composition
features.description: Enable users to create blog posts that combine textual content (titles, body text) with uploaded images, allowing flexible placement of images within the post body.

features.name: Image-Embedded Post Display
features.description: Render published blog posts with properly formatted text and embedded images, ensuring images are displayed in correct dimensions and aligned appropriately within the post content.

requirements.target_users: Individual bloggers, content creators, or anyone seeking to share text-and-image-based content on a simple personal blog platform.
requirements.data_requirements: Storage for blog post metadata (titles, body text, publication dates) and uploaded image files (or references to stored images like file paths/URLs) to persist content for ongoing access.

tasks.name: 创建博客与图片数据库模型
tasks.description: 创建用于存储博客文章和图片资源的数据库模型。在app/models/目录下创建blog_post.py，包含字段：id（主键）、title（博客标题）、content（富文本内容）、created_at（创建时间）、updated_at（更新时间）；创建image_asset.py，包含字段：id（主键）、file_path（图片存储路径）、file_name（原文件名）、blog_post_id（关联的博客文章ID，外键）、uploaded_at（上传时间）。

tasks.name: 开发博客CRUD与图片上传API
tasks.description: 开发支持博客文章管理和图片上传的后端API路由。在app/routes/目录下创建blog_routes.py，实现以下接口：1. 博客文章的创建、查询（单篇/列表）、更新、删除接口；2. 图片上传接口，处理图片文件存储、生成访问路径，并关联到指定博客文章；3. 配置静态资源路由以支持图片访问。

tasks.name: 开发富文本博客创作前端页面
tasks.description: 创建支持富文本编辑和图片上传的博客创作页面。在templates/目录下创建create_blog.html，包含博客标题输入框、富文本编辑器、图片上传按钮、发布与保存草稿按钮；在static/js/目录下创建create_blog.js，处理富文本编辑器交互、图片上传的前端逻辑及表单提交。

tasks.name: 开发博客列表与详情展示页面
tasks.description: 创建用于展示带图片的博客内容的前端页面。在templates/目录下创建blog_list.html，展示博客文章列表（包含标题、摘要、发布时间）；创建blog_detail.html，展示博客标题、发布时间、富文本内容（含嵌入图片）；在static/css/目录下创建blog_style.css，定义列表和详情页的基础样式。

tasks.name: 前端交互优化与系统整合
tasks.description: 优化博客系统的整体交互体验与页面整合。在templates/目录下创建或修改base.html，添加导航栏（含博客首页、写博客链接）；在static/js/目录下创建common.js，实现博客列表分页、图片懒加载效果；更新static/css/blog_style.css，优化响应式布局与页面样式一致性。

T1.implementation_approach: 使用ORM框架（如SQLAlchemy、Sequelize）定义Blog和Image模型，Blog包含标题、内容、创建时间等字段，Image包含文件URL、关联博客ID等字段，建立一对多的外键关联关系
T1.notes: 需设置外键约束，为创建时间等高频查询字段添加索引，考虑使用云存储或本地文件系统存储图片文件

T2.implementation_approach: 基于Flask/Django REST Framework或Express构建RESTful API，实现博客的CRUD接口，同时开发图片上传接口，处理多表单数据请求，验证文件类型后存储文件并将URL关联到对应博客
T2.notes: 添加身份验证与权限控制，对输入内容做合法性校验，处理文件上传异常并返回标准HTTP状态码

T3.implementation_approach: 使用React/Vue等前端框架搭建富文本创作页面，集成Quill.js或TinyMCE富文本编辑器，实现标题输入、内容编辑、图片上传插入功能，表单提交时调用博客创建/更新API
T3.notes: 支持自动保存功能防止数据丢失，适配移动端响应式布局，确保编辑器与后端API的图片上传逻辑无缝对接

T4.implementation_approach: 开发博客列表页和详情页，列表页通过API获取博客数据并以卡片式布局展示摘要信息，详情页渲染富文本内容及关联图片，使用前端路由实现页面跳转
T4.notes: 为列表页实现分页或无限滚动，对图片做懒加载优化，对富文本内容进行XSS安全过滤

T5.implementation_approach: 优化前端交互体验，添加加载状态、错误提示和操作反馈，整合前后端所有模块，测试端到端业务流程（创作-展示-编辑-删除），并进行性能优化（代码分割、缓存）
T5.notes: 开展跨浏览器兼容性测试，修复响应式布局问题，通过用户测试优化交互细节，确保系统稳定运行

# Flask Base Framework Template
# This file defines the standard Flask project structure
# AI can read this file as reference to generate code that follows framework conventions

## File Structure

flask_base/
├── app/
│   ├── __init__.py      # App factory - register blueprints here
│   ├── models/
│   │   └── __init__.py  # Models package
│   └── routes/
│       └── __init__.py  # Routes package
├── templates/
│   └── index.html       # Frontend template
├── static/
│   └── static files (CSS, JS, images)
├── config.py            # Multi-environment config
├── app.py               # Entry point
├── requirements.txt     # Dependencies
└── .env                # Environment variables

## Key Interface Specifications Example

### 1. Model Specification (app/models/__init__.py)
```python
from app import db

class ModelName(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'table_name'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    # Other fields...

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            'id': self.id,
            # Other fields...
        }
```

### 2. Route Specification (app/routes/xxx.py)
```python
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify
from app import db
from app.models.xxx import ModelName

xxx_bp = Blueprint('xxx', __name__)

@xxx_bp.route('/xxx', methods=['GET'])
def get_xxx():
    items = ModelName.query.all()
    return jsonify([item.to_dict() for item in items])

@xxx_bp.route('/xxx', methods=['POST'])
def create_xxx():
    data = request.get_json()
    item = ModelName(field=data['field'])
    db.session.add(item)
    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify(item.to_dict()), 201
```

### 3. Blueprint Registration Specification (app/__init__.py)
```python
# Import blueprints
from app.routes.xxx import xxx_bp

# Register blueprints
app.register_blueprint(xxx_bp, url_prefix='/api')
```

### 4. Frontend Template Specification (templates/xxx.html)
```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Title</title>
    <script>
        const API_BASE = '/api';
        // Use fetch to call API
    </script>
</head>
<body>
    <!-- Page content -->
</body>
</html>
```

### 5. Frontend Route Specification (app/__init__.py)
```python
# Frontend route - serves the main HTML page
@app.route('/')
def index():
    return render_template('index.html')

# Or for single-page applications:
@app.route('/<path:catch_all>')
def spa(catch_all):
    return render_template('index.html')
```

## Common Modification Files

1. **app/__init__.py** - Register new blueprints AND add frontend routes
2. **app/models/__init__.py** - Add new model imports
3. **app/routes/__init__.py** - Add new route imports
4. **app/routes/xxx.py** - Create new route file
5. **app/models/xxx.py** - Create new model file
6. **templates/xxx.html** - Create new frontend page
7. **config.py** - Add configuration (optional)
8. **requirements.txt** - Add dependencies (optional)

## Frontend Routing

For a complete web application, you need both:
- **API routes**: `/api/xxx` - Handle data operations (JSON)
- **Frontend routes**: `/` or `/xxx` - Serve HTML pages

Example frontend route setup:
```python
from flask import Flask, render_template

app = Flask(__name__)

# Serve main page
@app.route('/')
def index():
    return render_template('index.html')

# Serve specific pages
@app.route('/notes')
def notes_page():
    return render_template('notes.html')

# SPA mode - catch all routes
@app.route('/<path:catch_all>')
def spa(catch_all):
    return render_template('index.html')
```

"""
Flask 应用工厂
框架代码，不包含具体业务逻辑
"""
import os
from flask import Flask, render_template
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy
from flask_cors import CORS
from config import get_config

db = SQLAlchemy()

# 项目根目录
BASE_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


def create_app(config_name=None):
    """应用工厂函数"""
    # 设置模板路径
    template_dir = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, 'templates')
    app = Flask(__name__, template_folder=template_dir)

    # 加载配置
    if config_name:
        app.config.from_object(config_name)
    else:
        app.config.from_object(get_config())

    # 初始化扩展
    db.init_app(app)

    # CORS 支持
    CORS(app)

    # ==== 在这里注册业务蓝图 ====
    # from app.routes.xxx import xxx_bp
    # app.register_blueprint(xxx_bp, url_prefix='/api')
    # ==============================

    # 首页路由
    @app.route('/')
    def index():
        return render_template('index.html')

    # 健康检查
    @app.route('/health')
    def health():
        return {'status': 'ok'}

    # 创建数据库表
    with app.app_context():
        db.create_all()

    return app

# Image-Enabled Blog Webpage

A user-friendly blog webpage that supports creating, publishing, and viewing blog posts with integrated image upload functionality, allowing users to enhance textual content with visual media.

## Setup
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```

## Features
- Image Upload for Blog Posts: Provide an interface for users to select and upload images from their local device to include in blog posts, with support for common formats (JPG, PNG, GIF) and basic validation for file size and type to ensure compatibility.
- Rich Blog Post Composition: Enable users to create blog posts that combine textual content (titles, body text) with uploaded images, allowing flexible placement of images within the post body.
- Image-Embedded Post Display: Render published blog posts with properly formatted text and embedded images, ensuring images are displayed in correct dimensions and aligned appropriately within the post content.
